description: Spoken symbol forms that must become written symbols: flags (dash dash), paths (slash, dot), versions, ports, globs, assignments. Full pipeline; the polish stage owns the transform.

cases.spokenForm: run the deploy script with dash dash force and tell me if it complains
cases.intendedText: Run the deploy script with --force and tell me if it complains.
cases.notes: Canonical long-flag dictation.

cases.spokenForm: run npm install dash dash save dev vitest
cases.intendedText: Run `npm install --save-dev vitest`.
cases.notes: Hyphenated long flag inside a backticked command.

cases.spokenForm: list the directory with l s dash l a
cases.intendedText: List the directory with `ls -la`.
cases.notes: Letter-spelled command plus bundled short flags.

cases.spokenForm: rerun it with dash v for verbose output
cases.intendedText: Rerun it with -v for verbose output.
cases.notes: Single-letter short flag; must not be absorbed into the next word.

cases.spokenForm: pin node to version twenty two point three point one in the engines field
cases.intendedText: Pin Node to version 22.3.1 in the engines field.
cases.notes: Spoken semver → dotted digits.

cases.spokenForm: the local server listens on port eight thousand eighty not eight thousand
cases.intendedText: The local server listens on port 8080, not 8000.
cases.notes: Two near-identical port numbers in one sentence.

cases.spokenForm: curl the health endpoint at localhost colon eight four seven two slash health
cases.intendedText: Curl the health endpoint at localhost:8472/health.
cases.notes: Digit-by-digit port (the polishd port) plus a path segment.

cases.spokenForm: check whether uv is installed under slash u s r slash local slash bin
cases.intendedText: Check whether uv is installed under /usr/local/bin.
cases.notes: Absolute path with a letter-spelled segment.

cases.spokenForm: the config lives in tilde slash dot config slash localvoxtral
cases.intendedText: The config lives in ~/.config/localvoxtral.
cases.notes: Tilde expansion plus a dotted directory.

cases.spokenForm: copy dot env dot example to dot env and fill in the token
cases.intendedText: Copy .env.example to .env and fill in the token.
cases.notes: Two dotfiles, one a prefix of the other.

cases.spokenForm: set log level equals debug in the environment
cases.intendedText: Set LOG_LEVEL=debug in the environment.
cases.notes: Spoken 'equals' → '=' plus SCREAMING_SNAKE env var inference.

cases.spokenForm: bump the dependency to caret one point five
cases.intendedText: Bump the dependency to ^1.5.
cases.notes: Spoken caret range operator.

cases.spokenForm: delete every star dot tmp file under the build directory
cases.intendedText: Delete every *.tmp file under the build directory.
cases.notes: Glob pattern dictated with 'star'.

cases.spokenForm: run the script and pipe the output into grep dash i error
cases.intendedText: Run the script and pipe the output into `grep -i error`.
cases.notes: Short flag inside a grep invocation; 'pipe' here is the verb, not '|'.

cases.spokenForm: run swift test dash dash filter text merging
cases.intendedText: Run `swift test --filter TextMerging`.
cases.notes: The repo's own test-filter idiom; PascalCase target from two spoken words.

cases.spokenForm: lance le script de déploiement avec tiret tiret force
cases.intendedText: Lance le script de déploiement avec --force.
cases.notes: French long-flag dictation ('tiret tiret').

cases.spokenForm: épingle node à la version vingt-deux point trois
cases.intendedText: Épingle Node à la version 22.3.
cases.notes: French spoken version number.

cases.spokenForm: le serveur local écoute sur le port huit mille quatre-vingts
cases.intendedText: Le serveur local écoute sur le port 8080.
cases.notes: French number words → port digits.

cases.spokenForm: vérifie que uv est installé sous slash u s r slash local slash bin
cases.intendedText: Vérifie que uv est installé sous /usr/local/bin.
cases.notes: French sentence around an English-spelled path.

cases.spokenForm: copie point env point example vers point env
cases.intendedText: Copie .env.example vers .env.
cases.notes: French 'point' as the dot word for dotfiles.

cases.spokenForm: relance la commande avec tiret v pour le mode verbeux
cases.intendedText: Relance la commande avec -v pour le mode verbeux.
cases.notes: French short flag.

cases.spokenForm: supprime tous les fichiers étoile point tmp du dossier de build
cases.intendedText: Supprime tous les fichiers *.tmp du dossier de build.
cases.notes: French glob dictation ('étoile' = star).
